title: perebea mollis subsp. lecithogalacta
intro: Perebea mollis subsp. lecithogalacta, commonly known as a species of plant in the Rubiaceae family, is a type of woody climber native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it useful in treating various ailments, including fever, wounds, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Perebea mollis subsp. lecithogalacta include its ability to modulate the immune system, inhibit the growth of pathogens, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
